name: livel
description: Read and update your Livel CRM from the conversation: find clients, analyze deals, create records, move pipeline stages and design new pipelines.

interface.longDescription:
Livel is a CRM for small and mid-sized businesses that adapts to each trade: brokers, wealth advisors, real-estate agents, associations, craftsmen. Connect it to your assistant to work on your CRM without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Find any record by name and read its details.
- Analyze your data: deals won this month, clients without follow-up, pipeline value by stage.
- Create, update and delete records, such as contacts, companies and deals.
- Change your CRM's structure: add objects and fields, create table, board or calendar views, arrange the workspace navigation and dashboards.
- Find files and get download links, send an email from your connected mailbox.

You choose which workspaces the assistant may reach and with which rights when you connect; it never goes beyond your own permissions. Deletions, structure changes and sent emails are flagged as destructive so your assistant asks you first, and every change appears in the workspace history. You can disconnect the assistant at any time from Livel's settings.
defaultPrompt: Which of my clients have had no follow-up for more than 30 days?
Add Claire Martin, director at Atlas, to my contacts.
Summarize this month: deals won, deals lost and total amount signed.

positive.description: Finds the contacts whose follow-up is overdue, with a read-only query on the workspace's people.
positive.prompt: In Livel, which of my contacts have had no follow-up since before October 1, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists one contact: Thomas Leroy (Cabinet Leroy Patrimoine), last follow-up on September 29, 2026.

positive.description: Finds a deal by name and reads its details.
positive.prompt: Find the Durand deal in Livel and tell me its stage and amount.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the deal "Mandat de gestion Durand" (Durand Immobilier): stage proposal, amount €18,500, expected signature on December 15, 2026.

positive.description: Creates a contact linked to an existing organization.
positive.prompt: In Livel, add Claire Martin from Atlas to my contacts, email claire.martin@atlas-conseil.fr.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the person Claire Martin with that email, linked to the organization Atlas, and confirms the creation.

positive.description: Moves a deal to another pipeline stage.
positive.prompt: Move the Durand deal to the Negotiation stage in Livel.
positive.expected_behavior: The deal "Mandat de gestion Durand" moves from proposal to negotiation; the assistant confirms the change.

positive.description: Analyzes the deals closed in a month with an aggregate query.
positive.prompt: Summarize my Livel deals closed in November 2026: how many were won, how many lost, and the total amount won.
positive.expected_behavior: 3 deals won for €29,000 (Accompagnement Atlas 2027 €24,000, Site vitrine Garage Petit €3,200, Gestion des adhérents Les Amis du Port €1,800) and 1 lost (Audit patrimonial Leroy, €9,500).

negative.description: A general question unrelated to the user's CRM: Livel should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: General writing with no CRM data involved: Livel should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: General knowledge about CRMs, not about the user's data: Livel should not be called.
negative.prompt: Explain what a CRM is in general terms.
